title: GGSIPU Directorate of Students' Welfare – Financial Assistance under EWS Scheme
summary: All students of MAIT and MAIMS are hereby informed that Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU) offers the Merit-cum-Means Linked Financial Assistance Scheme to provide tuition fee remission to eligible students from economically weaker sections. Eligibility Criteria T...
full_content: All students of MAIT and MAIMS are hereby informed that Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU) offers the Merit-cum-Means Linked Financial Assistance Scheme to provide tuition fee remission to eligible students from economically weaker sections. Eligibility Criteria The applicant must be a bonafide student of GGSIPU studying in a University School or an affiliated institution, as applicable. The annual family income should be within the prescribed limits. The student must satisfy the academic performance requirements prescribed by GGSIPU. The student should maintain good conduct and satisfactory attendance as per University/Institute norms. The applicant should submit a valid Income Certificate and all other prescribed supporting documents. The grant of financial assistance is subject to the approval of GGSIPU and the availability of funds. Documents Required Duly filled online application form. Family Income Certificate issued by the Competent Authority. Aadhaar Card. Student Identity Card. Latest fee receipt. Bank account details (Aadhaar-linked). Any other document as prescribed by GGSIPU. Eligible students are advised to submit their applications within the prescribed timeline as notified by the University. For detailed guidelines and application procedure, please visit the Directorate of Students' Welfare (DSW), GGSIPU: GGSIPU Directorate of Students' Welfare – Financial Assistance under EWS Scheme For any query please contact Mr. Neeraj Sharma, Jt. Registrar
html_content:
All students of MAIT and MAIMS are hereby informed that Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU) offers the Merit-cum-Means Linked Financial Assistance Scheme to provide tuition fee remission to eligible students from economically weaker sections.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The applicant must be a bonafide student of GGSIPU studying in a University School or an affiliated institution, as applicable.
  • The annual family income should be within the prescribed limits.
  • The student must satisfy the academic performance requirements prescribed by GGSIPU.
  • The student should maintain good conduct and satisfactory attendance as per University/Institute norms.
  • The applicant should submit a valid Income Certificate and all other prescribed supporting documents.
  • The grant of financial assistance is subject to the approval of GGSIPU and the availability of funds.

Documents Required

  • Duly filled online application form.
  • Family Income Certificate issued by the Competent Authority.
  • Aadhaar Card.
  • Student Identity Card.
  • Latest fee receipt.
  • Bank account details (Aadhaar-linked).
  • Any other document as prescribed by GGSIPU.

Eligible students are advised to submit their applications within the prescribed timeline as notified by the University.

For detailed guidelines and application procedure, please visit the Directorate of Students' Welfare (DSW), GGSIPU:

  • GGSIPU Directorate of Students' Welfare – Financial Assistance under EWS Scheme

For any query please contact Mr. Neeraj Sharma, Jt. Registrar
